name: Delete TLS setting for hostname
description: Delete TLS setting for hostname Delete the tls setting value for the hostname. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/hostnames/settings/{setting_id}/{hostname}

name: Get TLS setting for hostname
description: Get TLS setting for hostname Get the requested TLS setting for the hostname. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/hostnames/settings/{setting_id}/{hostname}

name: List TLS setting for hostnames
description: List TLS setting for hostnames List the requested TLS setting for the hostnames under this zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/hostnames/settings/{setting_id}

name: Edit TLS setting for hostname
description: Edit TLS setting for hostname Update the tls setting value for the hostname. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/hostnames/settings/{setting_id}/{hostname}
